results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite (if scope unknown)]: Discover accessible scope using CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES (choose target workspace/team).
[Required] [Step]: Find candidate docs by keyword using CLICKUP_SEARCH_DOCS (paginate via next_cursor until missing/empty; collect doc hits/snippets).
[Required] [Step]: Enumerate tasks using CLICKUP_GET_FILTERED_TEAM_TASKS (page=0.. until data.last_page=true; locally keyword-match on name+description with null-safe handling).
[Optional (if list identifiers are known and you want a narrower scan)] [Step]: Retrieve list-scoped tasks using CLICKUP_GET_TASKS (paginate until data.last_page=true; locally keyword-match).
[Optional (if open-only scan yields too few hits)] [Fallback]: Re-run CLICKUP_GET_FILTERED_TEAM_TASKS with closed items included (repeat pagination + local matching).

[Optional (if matches need confirmation or context may be in discussion)] [Next Step]: Deep-verify shortlisted items using CLICKUP_GET_TASK and CLICKUP_GET_TASK_COMMENTS (paginate comments via start/start_id as needed).

[Optional (if doc snippets are insufficient or output is truncated)] [Next Step]: Identify pages using CLICKUP_GET_DOC_PAGE_LISTING, fetch targeted text using CLICKUP_GET_DOC_PAGE_CONTENT, and optionally use COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH to chunk/scan/dedupe results.
known_pitfalls: [CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES] Scope/auth failures may surface as 404 not_found_or_authorized or ToolNotFound-style errors (including code 2401).
[CLICKUP_SEARCH_DOCS] Pagination may end with next_cursor as an empty string; treat falsey cursor as end-of-results.
[CLICKUP_GET_FILTERED_TEAM_TASKS] tasks[*].description can be null and some calls return tasks=[]; keep matching null-safe and stop only on data.last_page=true.
[CLICKUP_GET_FILTERED_TEAM_TASKS] High-volume pagination can trigger HTTP 429; apply backoff/retry and consider narrowing scope (e.g., list-scoped scan).
[CLICKUP_GET_TASK_COMMENTS] Older-comment pagination uses start/start_id; some tasks legitimately return comments=[].

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Paginate CLICKUP_GET_FILTERED_TEAM_TASKS to completion and filter locally by keyword
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import re
rx=re.compile(r"KW1|KW2",re.I)
page=0
hits=[]
while True:
  resp,err=run_composio_tool('CLICKUP_GET_FILTERED_TEAM_TASKS',{'team_Id':'SCOPE','page':page})
  data=(resp or {}).get('data') or {}
  for t in (data.get('tasks') or []):
    hay=((t.get('name') or '')+'\n'+(t.get('description') or ''))
    if rx.search(hay): hits.append(t.get('id'))
  if data.get('last_page'): break
  page+=1
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Normalize text before client-side matching (including removing diacritics)
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import re,unicodedata

def norm(s):
  s=unicodedata.normalize('NFD',s or '')
  s=''.join(ch for ch in s if unicodedata.category(ch)!='Mn')
  return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s).lower().strip()
```

CLICKUP_SEARCH_DOCS.description: Tool to search and list Docs metadata in a ClickUp workspace. Use after confirming the workspace ID to quickly locate relevant meeting notes before fetching pages.

limit.description: Maximum results per page. Default: 50, max: 100.

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response to fetch next page.

workspace_id.description: ID of the ClickUp Workspace to list Docs from.

CLICKUP_GET_FILTERED_TEAM_TASKS.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tasks (up to 100 per page) from a specified workspace based on various filter criteria, respecting user access permissions. Unexpectedly missing tasks may indicate permission restrictions rather than filter issues. Task comments are not included; use CLICKUP_GET_TASK_COMMENTS for complete context. No keyword/text search is supported; filter client-side on returned results.

page.description: Page to fetch (starts at 0). Increment until the response's `last_page` field is true or the returned tasks list is empty to avoid silently missing tasks.

parent.description: Filter by parent task ID to retrieve its subtasks.

reverse.description: If true, tasks are displayed in reverse order.

team_Id.description: The Workspace ID (called 'team_id' in ClickUp API v2). This is a numeric string. To find your Workspace ID, use the 'Get Authorized Teams (Workspaces)' endpoint or check Settings > Workspace Settings in the ClickUp UI.

team_id.description: Team ID, required if `custom_task_ids` is true, for custom task ID context. Distinct from the required `team_Id` path parameter (Workspace ID); do not confuse these — this optional numeric string is only used for custom task ID resolution. Example: '9001'.

list_ids.description: Filter by List IDs. Must be numeric IDs (e.g., '123456789'). You can get numeric List IDs from the Get Lists endpoint.

order_by.description: Order tasks by this field. Default: `created`.

statuses.description: Filter by task statuses (e.g., 'to do', 'in progress'). Values must exactly match workspace-configured status strings; mismatches silently return empty results.

subtasks.description: If true, include subtasks. Excluded by default.

assignees.description: Filter by assignee User IDs. Must be numeric IDs (e.g., '123456789'). You can get numeric User IDs from endpoints like Get List Members or Get Task Members.

space_ids.description: Filter by Space IDs. Must be numeric IDs (e.g., '123456789'). You can get numeric Space IDs from the Get Spaces endpoint.

due_date_gt.description: Filter by due date greater than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

due_date_lt.description: Filter by due date less than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

project_ids.description: Filter by Folder (Project) IDs. Must be numeric IDs (e.g., '123456789'). You can get numeric Folder IDs from the Get Folders endpoint.

custom_items.description: Filter by custom item types (e.g., 0 for tasks, 1 for Milestones, other numbers for custom types defined in Workspace).

date_done_gt.description: Filter by completion date greater than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

date_done_lt.description: Filter by completion date less than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

custom_fields.description: Filter by custom fields. Each string in the list is a JSON object defining a single filter condition. Example for one string in the list: '''{"field_id": "unique_field_id", "operator": "=", "value": "desired_value"}'''. Incorrect `field_id` values or unsupported operator strings produce 400 errors or silently empty results; retrieve valid `field_id`s from workspace custom field configuration.

include_closed.description: If true, include closed tasks. Excluded by default.

custom_task_ids.description: Set to true to use custom task IDs in filters instead of global task IDs. Requires `team_id` for context.

date_created_gt.description: Filter by creation date greater than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

date_created_lt.description: Filter by creation date less than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

date_updated_gt.description: Filter by update date greater than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

date_updated_lt.description: Filter by update date less than this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

include_markdown_description.description: If true, return task descriptions in Markdown format.
